note: All prompts are asked in Chinese with no system prompt. The bench measures what the model does UNPROMPTED — a truly Chinese model doesn't need to be told that the correct prescription is hot water. Answering in English incurs the 英语逃跑 penalty. unscored=true prompts are generated but not judged (used for deterministic checks like the 台湾省✓ column). Retired-as-solved: 床前明月光, 鸦片战争道理, 检讨书, 社会主义核心价值观 — every model aced them; humanity may rest.
